ai_support_questions.question: What is Silkhaus?
answers: Silkhaus offers furnished apartments designed for flexible stays. The experience combines home-style comfort with hotel-like standards and mobile-first support.
Silkhaus is a tech-enabled furnished apartment operator for short and long stays, focused on self check-in, equipped homes and reliable guest support.

ai_support_questions.question: Can I extend my stay?
answers: Extensions are usually possible when the apartment is available. Share your preferred checkout date with Silkhaus support and the team can confirm availability and pricing.
Silkhaus supports flexible stays from short visits to longer monthly stays. I can connect you with support to check whether {property_name} is available for your new dates.

ai_support_questions.question: How does self check-in work?
answers: For {property_name}, check-in is from {check_in_time}. Use the building instructions and smart lock code from your confirmed booking details. Your current demo access code is included in the check-in menu.
Self check-in means you can arrive without waiting at a front desk. Follow the apartment access steps, keep ID ready for building security, and contact Silkhaus support if access needs help.

ai_support_questions.question: Is Wi-Fi included?
answers: Yes. High speed Wi-Fi is included at {property_name}. Your network is {wifi_network} and the password is {wifi_password}.
Wi-Fi is ready in the apartment. Connect to {wifi_network} using password {wifi_password}.

ai_support_questions.question: What amenities are included?
